results.title: Steadfast Woman
results.overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

results.title: friends& - Man of Constant Sorrow
results.overview: the friends& man of constant sorrow music video is about loving 00s indie rock music while reckoning with its commercialization. the video imagines a futuristic stomp-clap band that makes the streets of Williamsburg their stage — like a demented arcade fire or edward sharpe and the magnetic zeros. tormented by a 5.7 pitchfork score, the couple at the centre of the band, played by william banks and lea rose sebastianis, descend into a frenzy of ketamine use and emotional abuse. directed by nate wilson and dozzy chroma.

results.overview: A distinguished art lecturer becomes possessed by his own art when he develops an inappropriate attraction to one of his male students.

results.title: No One is Closer Than We
results.overview: When Li Weiyang's motorcycle crash left his girlfriend with missing front teeth, he struggled to afford implants by negotiating with the at-fault driver and insurers, upending their modest but stable life.

results.title: Masques, Monsters and Madmen - Part 1
results.overview: Part 1 of a new, feature-length documentary about AIP, one of Hammer's main competitors in '60s/'70s British horror.

results.title: Dukun Magang
results.overview: Raka is a final-year student frustrated by the constant rejection of his thesis by his lecturers. Sekar, his college friend, suggests that his thesis explore the world of shamanism. Meanwhile, Mbah Djambrong is a legendary and eccentric shaman from Kalimati, a remote village renowned for its supernatural traditions, holding mysteries about humanity's relationship with the mystical and spiritual world.

results.title: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
results.original_title: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
results.overview: What was once considered a childhood hobby has evolved into a billion-dollar global marketplace. Signed, Sealed & Delivered takes audiences inside the high-stakes world of sports collectibles, where rare trading cards, signed jerseys, and historic memorabilia have become status symbols, emotional investments, and financial assets. Through exclusive access, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, the documentary explores the personalities and businesses driving the hobby's modern explosion. Featuring appearances and commentary tied to sports and business icons including Lionel Messi, Kevin O'Leary, and Gary Vaynerchuk, the film uncovers the culture, psychology, risks, and financial opportunities behind the booming collectibles industry — while asking what people are truly chasing when they spend fortunes trying to own a piece of sports history.

results.title: Purple Lingerie
results.overview: A single mother raising her child alone encounters a piece of purple lingerie that awakens her long-suppressed desire for intimacy, leading her to reclaim an identity beyond motherhood.

results.title: Defender
results.overview: In a small village, Henrik Olinger, a faithful father and husband continually trains himself to protect what is good and beautiful. As he tries to convince his village of an imminent barbarian attack, he is mocked and rejected. Henrik is thrown into a bloody assault forced to defend all he loves alone.

results.title: The Heartbreak Kid: Becoming Shawn Michaels
results.original_title: The Heartbreak Kid: Becoming Shawn Michaels
results.overview: Follows the life and career of WWE performer Shawn Michaels, tracing his rise, personal struggles, and eventual comeback with an unfiltered look at his journey.

results.title: Wind
results.overview: In a time after devastating wars, plagues, and natural disasters, the social order has collapsed, and new moral systems, beliefs, and forms of survival emerge. The story follows Ivan Morozov, who leaves his wife Katya to search for necessities, and meets Sergei Volkov, a mysterious companion. Together, they travel through haunting landscapes filled with forgotten villages, strange rituals, and mythological echoes, culminating in a profound and painful choice.

results.title: Космическая Машка
results.overview: Masha spent her entire 11 years of life with her cosmonaut father at the spaceport. She knows how to fly a plane, a boat, and take responsibility for herself, but she doesn't know how her peers live. To make friends and get used to life on Earth, she goes to a regular school in St. Petersburg, where her incredible adventures begin.

results.title: Eurokryvbas
results.overview: Belgian trams, French and British capital, German factories, Mennonite settlers from Prussia: the industrial heart of today's Ukraine was once deeply European. In Soviet times, this history vanished from collective memory. Eurokryvbas digs it up again, while war is being waged in the very same places today.

results.title: Worm
results.overview: A couple's one year anniversary in a remote Welsh country house is marked by mysterious emails sent by a deceased ex-boyfriend.
